sara-cs: Heads-up — Zenith Labs renewal in 4 weeks. Health scan shows two latency peaks on their primary route that could trigger a credit per SLA. Need verified metrics and an evidence bundle before renewal outreach. @devin-eng @mika-sre @terry-ops

devin-eng: Which metric window? Contract Appendix B says monthly measurement; CS playbook sometimes uses a 30d lookback. Confirming we should use the contract month. Route is /v1/generate/zenith-main.

sara-cs: Use contract month (last 30 days). SLA clause is Section 5.1: p95 <= 820ms. Exclude scheduled maint windows listed in the onboarding doc.

mika-sre: Running the query now. Obs snippet: `p95=905ms, uptime=99.72% (30d, route-level)`. Exporting CSV and sample traces to s3. I'll include the incident note for a 18m tail latency event on 2026-02-20 03:12 UTC caused by a node OOM and subsequent fallback.

terry-ops: Flag — there is a remediation offer ops can provide: 14-day reserved pool trial or a config tune (queue depth cap + cache warmer). Which should CS offer as goodwill?

sara-cs: Offer both as options in the outreach. If credit exceeds $200, include reserved trial by default.

legal-bot: Reminder: Per contract the credit tiers are discrete and capped at 50% monthly fees. Please include the exact contract clause when you notify customer.

devin-eng: Uploaded evidence: s3://redwood-evidence/zenith/2860471111/metrics_30d.csv and s3://redwood-evidence/zenith/2860471111/traces_sample.zip. Preliminary run of official_credit_calc with monthly_commit=$18,000 -> maps to tiered credit = $50.

sara-cs: Draft email to customer (short): "Hi Zenith — we completed the 30-day review for /v1/generate/zenith-main. Observed p95=905ms (SLA 820ms) and uptime=99.72% (SLA 99.9%). Per Section 5.1 and Appendix B, this yields a one-time credit of $50. Attached is the evidence bundle. As remediation we can provision a 14-day reserved-capacity trial or apply the credit to your next invoice. Let us know which you prefer." Please keep it factual and attach the S3 bundle.

mika-sre: Confirmed uploads and checksum. I'll add the incident timeline to the bundle and mark the internal postmortem.

sara-cs: Thanks — action items: mika finalize evidence bundle, devin run final calc and send draft to Legal, terry prepare runbook for trial. We'll wait for Legal ok before sending. Meeting Friday 09:00 PST to confirm. :calendar:
